SELECT o.id AS id, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.item_id AS itemId, o.item_title AS itemTitle, o.item_cover AS itemCover, o.amount AS amount, o.buyer_id AS buyerId, bu.username AS buyerUsername, bu.nickname AS buyerNickname, o.seller_id AS sellerId, su.username AS sellerUsername, su.nickname AS sellerNickname, o.pay_method AS payMethod, o.status AS status, o.trade_type AS tradeType, o.created_at AS createdAt, o.pay_time AS payTime FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_user bu ON bu.id = o.buyer_id LEFT JOIN t_user su ON su.id = o.seller_id WHERE o.deleted = 0
AND o.status = #{q.status}
AND (o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR o.item_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR bu.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR su.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC

SELECT o.id AS id, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.item_id AS itemId, o.item_title AS itemTitle, o.item_cover AS itemCover, o.amount AS amount, o.buyer_id AS buyerId, bu.username AS buyerUsername, bu.nickname AS buyerNickname, o.seller_id AS sellerId, su.username AS sellerUsername, su.nickname AS sellerNickname, o.pay_method AS payMethod, o.status AS status, o.trade_type AS tradeType, o.created_at AS createdAt, o.pay_time AS payTime FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_user bu ON bu.id = o.buyer_id LEFT JOIN t_user su ON su.id = o.seller_id WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.id = #{id}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) FROM t_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status IN ('TO_SHIP', 'TO_RECEIVE', 'TO_MEET', 'DONE')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= CURDATE() AND created_at < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM t_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.created_at >= #{start} AND o.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
